title: Heart-Eyes Cat Emoji 😻 Meaning: Adoration With Whiskers
description: The 😻 smiling cat with heart-eyes emoji means you adore something or find someone gorgeous. See how it is used for pets, crushes and compliments.
summary: The 😻 smiling cat with heart-eyes emoji shows a cat whose eyes have turned into red hearts. It means adoration: you love what you are seeing, whether that is a cute animal, an attractive person, or something you badly want. It is the cat counterpart of 😍.
meaning: Heart eyes are the cartoon sign for being smitten on sight, and 😻 applies them to a cat. People send it in response to a photo more than anything else: a friend's new haircut, a kitten, a plate of pasta, a pair of shoes. The message is 'I love this' with an added squeal. It is one of the most used cat faces because it fits so naturally under pictures of actual cats.

As a compliment to a person, it says they look gorgeous. It is a little softer and more playful than 😍, which makes it popular between friends hyping each other's selfies without sounding like a come-on. From someone who is interested in you, though, it works as flirtation, particularly as a reply to a photo. The cat does not dilute the meaning much; heart eyes are heart eyes.

The emoji has a strong presence in fandoms and pet communities, and in the wider 'cute' aesthetic influenced by Japanese kawaii style, which is where the cat faces originated before Unicode adopted them in 2010. It has no ironic or coded use. If someone sends 😻, they like what they see.

contexts.label: On pet posts
contexts.body: Under cat photos, 😻 is close to mandatory. It tells an owner their pet is adorable, and owners use it themselves when posting kittens, fluffy bellies, or a cat asleep in a ridiculous position. Shelters use it on adoption listings to draw attention to animals that need homes.

contexts.label: From a crush
contexts.body: Sent in reply to your picture, it means they find you attractive. It is slightly less forward than 😍 or 🥵, so shy people favor it. One 😻 is a compliment; a pattern of them on everything you post is a fairly clear sign of interest.

contexts.label: In comments and captions
contexts.body: Friends flood each other's posts with 😻 as supportive hype. It is also used for desirable things: outfits, apartments, desserts, travel views. Brands in beauty, fashion, and pet care use it to mirror the reaction they hope customers will have.

examples.meaning: An enthusiastic compliment on how someone looks.

examples.text: We're fostering three kittens this month 😻
examples.meaning: The sender is overflowing with love for the kittens.

examples.text: Look at this apartment listing, the windows 😻
examples.meaning: They have fallen for something they want.
A flirty or admiring reaction to someone's photo.
Food so good it inspires devotion.

combos.meaning: Adoring a cat or other pet.
Someone looks both lovely and hot.
Extra affection, often between close friends.

confusedWith.difference: 😍 is the human version and the more common choice in romantic contexts. 😻 means the same thing with a cuter, lighter tone, and is the natural pick for anything involving cats or pets.
😽 offers a kiss, an action directed at someone, and often closes a message. 😻 is a reaction to how something looks. One gives affection, the other shows admiration.
🥰 shows a face surrounded by hearts and expresses feeling loved or tender. 😻 is about being dazzled by something in front of you, closer to 'wow' than to 'aww.'

avoid: Do not send it to coworkers about their appearance, where heart eyes can cross a professional line.
Avoid it if you only mean polite approval, since it signals strong attraction or adoration.
design: The glyph is a cat's head with pointed ears, whiskers, an open smile, and two red hearts in place of eyes. Fur is yellow or orange on most platforms. Each vendor bases the face on its own cat set, so ear shape and mouth vary slightly, but the heart eyes are always large and red.

faqs.q: What does 😻 mean from a guy?
faqs.a: He thinks you, or what you posted, looks great. Guys who use the cat version are often being sweet rather than smooth. Replying to a selfie with it is a compliment and usually a sign of attraction.

faqs.q: What does 😻 mean from a girl?
faqs.a: It depends on the relationship. Between female friends it is everyday hype on photos and outfits. From a girl who might like you, sent about your picture, it is flirty admiration.
No. It is used for people, food, clothes, places, and anything else that inspires love at first sight. Cat owners simply have the most obvious reason to reach for it.
Both are possible. It is one of the more friend-safe ways to say someone looks good, but in a one-on-one chat with romantic tension it reads as flirting.
